name: Otonashi Yukino
source: She works for a publishing company, and is visiting Mihate Town for research. She has a bright attitude and is always optimistic. She recently made her authorial debut after her first article was published in a magazine. She s curious about the mysteries occurring in Mihate Town, and has been running around town looking for clues. She is also an honorary member of the Mystery Club.
